m: सं-√ या P. -याति, to go or proceed together, go, wander, travel, TS. &c. &c.; to come together, meet, encounter (as friends or foes), contend with (acc.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.; to come to or into, attain (any state or condition, e.g. एकतां सं-√ या, ‘to go to oneness, become one’), Mn.; MBh. &c.; to conform to (acc.), MBh.
a: संया — {c2c} P. 1 To go or proceed together. --2 To go away, depart, walk away; Bg. 15. 8. --3 To go to, go or enter into; तथा शरीराणि विहाय जीर्णान्यन्यानि संयाति नवानि देही Bg. 2. 22. --4 To reach or attain to. --5 To assemble, meet. --6 To fight. --7 To be directed towards, aim at.

m: सं-√ याच् Ā. -याचते, to ask, beg, implore, solicit, MBh.; BhP.
सं-याज m.
सं-याजन n. in पत्नी-संय्˚ (q.v.)
सं-˚याज्या (आ), f. N. of the Yājyā and Anuvākyā Mantras (recited in the Sviṣṭa-kṛt ceremony), Br.; ŚrS.
सं-˚याज्य mfn. to be made or allowed to sacrifice (see अ-संय्˚)
सं-˚याज्य n. joining or sharing in a sacrifice, sacrificing (see अ-याज्य-संय्˚)

s: puM, (saM + yama + “yamaH samupanivizu ca .” 3 । 3 । 63 । iti pakze GaY .) saMyamaH । ityamaraH ॥
m: सं-याम m. = सं-यम, Pāṇ. iii, 3, 63
a: संयाम — See संयम.

k.v: प्रवाहस्तु प्रवृत्तिः स्यात्प्रवहो गमनं बहिः। वियामो वियमो यामो यमः संयामसंयमौ॥

m: सं-याम—वत् mfn. self-controlled, Bhaṭṭ.
सं-यानी (˚यानी), f. N. of partic. bricks, Kāṭh.; ŚBr.

s: klI, samyaggamanam । saMpUrvvayADAtoranawa(lyuw) pratyayena nizpannam ॥ (yaTA, mahABArate । 3 । 19 । 5 । “sa tvaM sAtvatamuKyAdya labDasaMjYo yadfcCayA । paSya me hayasaMyAne SikzAM keSavanandana ! ॥” pretanirhAraH । yaTA, rAmAyaRe । 1 । 76 । 2 । “alaM Sokena BadraM te rAjaputtra mahAyaSaH । prAptakAlaM narapateH kuru saMyAnamuttamam ॥”)
m: सं-यान m. a mould, L.
सं-यान (अम्), n. going together, going along with (comp.), Kathās.
going, travelling a journey (with उत्तम, ‘the last j˚’, i.e. the carrying out of a dead body), MBh.; R.; Hariv.
setting out, departure, MBh.
a vehicle, waggon, car &c., R.; Mṛcch.
N. of partic. Sūktas, TS.
a: संयानः — A mould. --नं 1 Going along with, accompanying. --2 Travelling, proceeding. --3 Carrying out a dead body.

m: सं-यास m. making effort, exertion, VS.
सं-यात mfn. gone together, proceeded together, approached, come, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
सं-˚याति m. N. of a son of Nahuṣa, MBh.; BhP.
of a son of Pracinvat (Bahu-gava) and father of Ahaṃ-yāti, ib. (Hariv. सम्पाति).

s: strI, dvIpAntaragamanam । saMpUrvvo yAtirdvIpAntaragamanavfttistatastrAsusiti traH striyAmAp saMyAtrA । dvIpAntaragamanaM samyagyAtrA saMyAtrA vA । iti sAMyAtrikaSabdawIkAyAM BarataH ॥
m: सं-˚यात्रा f. travelling together (esp. by sea), L.
a: संयात्रा — Voyage by sea.

m: सं-˚यात्रिक w.r. for सां-यात्रिक.

s: puM, (saM + yu + “sami yudruduvaH .” 3 । 3 । 23 । iti GaY .) GftakzIrAdipakvagoDUmaH । yaTA, -- “saMyAvastu GftakzIraguqagoDUmapAkajaH .” iti SabdacandrikA ॥ pizwakaviSezaH । perAkI iti BAzA । yaTA, -- “paryyawyaH sAjyasamitA nirmmitA GftaBarjjitAH kuwwitAScAlitAH SudDAH SarkarABirvvimardditAH ॥ taccUrRe prakzipedelAM lavaNgamaricAni ca । nAlikelaM sakarpUraM vArabIjAnyanekaSaH ॥ GftAktasamitApuzwarowikA racitA tataH । tasyAM tatpuraRAttasya kuryyAnmudrAM dfQAM suDIH ॥ sarpizi pracure tAntu supacennipuRo janaH । prakArajYEH prakAro'yaM saMyAva iti kIrttitaH । maRWako'pi samo jYeyaH saMyAvo'pi guRErjanEH ॥” iti BAvaprakASaH ॥
v: pu॰ samyak GftAdiBiryUyate miSryate goDUmacURAdyatra sam + yu--ADAre GaY । “saMyAvastu GftakzIraguqagoDUmapAkajaH” ityukte GftAdinA pakvagoDUmacUrRe Sabdaca॰ ।
m: सं-˚याव m. a sort of cake (of wheaten flour fried with ghee and milk and made up into an oblong form with sugar and spices), Mn.; MBh. &c.
a: संयावः — A kind of cake of wheaten flour; Ms. 5. 7.

m: सं-य m. (fr. 2. सम् and √ यम्, or यत्) a skeleton, L.
सं-य See above.
a: संयः — A skeleton.
संयंतृ — m. One who restrains, a restrainer, curber.

m: सं-यद् in comp. for सं-यत्.

v: pu॰ vAmaM saMyAti sam + yA--Satf pfzo॰ pUrvanipatiH । akzipuruze “etaM hi akziRi puruza saMyadvAma ityA cakzate etaM hi sarvARi vAma nyaBimaMyanti” Ca ndegyopa॰ ।
m: सं-यद्—वाम mfn. uniting all that is pleasant or dear, ChUp.
सं-यद्—वीर (˚यद्-व्˚), mfn. abounding in heroes, RV.

s: puM, (saMyacCatoti । saM + yama + CitvaracCatvareti । uRA॰ 3 । 1 । iti zvaracpratyayena sADu .) nfpaH । ityuRAdikozaH ॥
v: pu॰ 6 ta॰ । niyantfRAM vare nfpe uRAdi॰ ।
m: सं-यद्—वर m. (cf. सम्पद्-वर) ‘chief in battle’, a prince, king, Uṇ. iii, 1.
सं-यद्—वसु (˚यद्-व्˚), mfn. having continuous wealth, VS.; AitBr.
सं-यद्—वसु m. one of the seven rays of the sun, VP., Sch.

सं-√ यज् P. Ā. -यजति, ˚ते, to worship together, offer sacrifices at the same time, RV.; Br.; ŚrS.; to sacrifice, worship, adore, honour, Hariv.; BhP.; to consecrate, dedicate, Bhaṭṭ. : Caus. -याजयति, to cause to sacrifice together, (esp.) to perform the Patnī-saṃyājas (q.v.), Br.; to perform a sacrifice for (acc.), MBh.
a: संयज् — {c1c} U. 1 To adore, worship; समयष्टास्त्रमंडलं Bk. 15. 96. --2 To consecrate, dedicate.

m: सं-√ यम् P. -यच्छति√ (rarely Ā.), to hold together, hold in, hold fast, restrain, curb, suppress, control, govern, guide (horses, the senses, passions), RV. &c. &c.; to tie up, bind together (hair or a garment), MBh.; Kāv. &c.; to put together, heap up (Ā. ‘for one's self’), Pāṇ. i, 3, 75, Sch.; to shut up, close (a door), Bhag.; to press close to or against, Suśr.; to present with, give to (Ā. with instr. of person, when the action is permitted P. with dat., when the action is not permitted), Pāṇ. i, 3, 55 : Caus. -यमयति (cf. -यमित), to cause to restrain &c.; to bind up (the hair), Veṇīs.
a: संयम् — {c1c} P. 1 To restrain, curb, check, control, govern, subdue (Atm.) (as passions &c.); असंयतात्मनो योगो दुष्प्राप इति मे मतिः Bg. 6. 36; Ms. 2. 100. --2 To bind, imprison, fasten, confine; वातरं मा न संयंसीः Bk. 9. 50; M. 1. 7; R. 3. 20, 42. --3 To gather (Atm.); व्री हीन्संयच्छते Sk. --4 To shut, close; Bg. 8. 12. --5 To hold together, hold fast. --6 To guide or drive (as horses). --7 (a) To collect. (b) To bind or tie into a knot (as hair); संयम्यमानशिखंडः V. 5. --8 To keep in order. --9 To present with, give to.

m: सं-य˚माग्नि m. the fire of abstinence, Bhag.
सं-य˚माम्भस् n. the flood of water at the end of the world, BhP.

s: [n] puM, (saMyamo'syAstIti । saMyama + iniH .) muniH । iti DaraRiH ॥ nigfhItendriye, tri । yaTA, -- “yA niSA sarvvaBUtAnAM tasyAM jAgartti saMyamI yasyAM jAgrati BUtAni sA niSA paSyato mune ॥” iti SrIBagavadgItAyAm 2 aDyAyaH ॥

puM, (saM + yama + “yamaH samupanivizu ca .” 3 । 3 । 63 । iti ap .) vratAdyaNgapUrvvadinakattavyAcAraH । tatparyyAyaH । viyAmaH 2 viyamaH 3 yAmaH 4 yamaH 5 saMyAmaH 6 । ityamaraH ॥ saMyamanam 7 niyamaH 8 iti DaraRiH ॥ tadviDAnaM yaTA । aTa daSamIniyamAH । sUrisantoze । “kAMsyaM mAMsaM masUraYca caRakaM koradUzakam । SAkaM maDu parAnnaYca tyajedupavasan striyam ॥” atropavasanniti taddine BojanAsamBavAt sAmIpyAt pUrvvAparadinayorgrahaRam । smftiH । “SAkaM mAzaM masUraYca punarBojanamETune । dyutamatyambupAnaYca daSamyAM vEzRavastyajet ॥ kAMsyaM mAMsaM surAM kzOdraM loBaM vitaTaBAzaRam । vyAyAmaYca vyavAyaYca divAsvapnaM taTAYjanam ॥ tilapizwaM masUraYca daSamyAM varjjayet pumAn । daSamyAkekaBaktaYca kurvvIta niyatendriyaH ॥ AcamyadantakAzWaYca KAdeta tadanantaram । pUrvvaM haridinAllokAH sevaDvaM cEkaBojanam ॥ avanIpfzWaSayanAH striyAH saNgavivarjitAH । sevaDvaM devadeveSaM purARaM puruzottamam । sakfdBojanasaMyuktA dvAdaSyAYca BavizyaTa ॥” ityekAdaSItattvam ॥ * ॥ SrAdDapUrvvadinakarttavyaniyamo yaTA । devalaH । “SvaH karttAsmIti niScitya dAtA viprAnnimantrayet । nirAmizaM sakft BuktvA sarvvamuptajane gfhe । asamBave paredyurvvA brAhmaRAMstAnnimantrayet ॥” varAhapurARam । “vastraSOcAdi karttavyaMSvaH karttAsmIti jAnatA । sTAnopalepanaYcEva kftvA viprAnnimantrayet । dantakAzWaYca visfjet brahmacArI SucirBavet ॥” visfjet SrAdDIyabrAhmaReByo dadyAt । mArkaRqayapurARam । “nimantrayecca pUrvvedyuH pUrvvoktAn dvijasattamAn । aprAptO taddine vApi hitvA yozitprasaNginam ॥” yamaH । “prATeyet pradozAnte BuktAnna SayitAn dDijAn । sarvvAyAsavinirmuktaH kAmakroDavivarjjitEH ॥ BavitavyaM BavadBiSca SvoBUte SrAdDakarmmaRi । dakziRaM jAnu cAlaBya tvaM mayAtra nimantritaH । evaM nimantrya niyamAn SrAvayet pEtfkAnbuDaH ॥” tanniyamamAha । “akroDanEH SOcaparEH satataM brahmacAriBiH । BavitavyaM BavadBiSca mayA ca SrAdDakarmmaRi ॥” iti SrAdDatattvam ॥ * ॥ tIrTayAtrApUrvvadinakarttavyaniyamamAha । brahmapurARam । “yo yaH kaScittIrTayAtrAntu gacCet susayataH sa ca pUrvvaM gfhe sve । kftopavAsaH SucirapramattaH saMpUjayedBaktinamro gaReSama ॥ devAn pitFn brAhmaRAMScEva sADUn DImAn prIRayan vittaSaktyA prayatnAt । pratyAgataScApi punastaTEva devAn pitFn brAhmaRAn pUjayecca ॥” evaM prakurvvatastasya tIrTAdyaduktaM PalaM tat syAnnAtra sandeha eva । susaMyataH pUrvvadine kftEkaBaktAdiniyamastaduttaradine kftopavAsa ityAdi । upavAsadine muRqanamapi । “prayAge tIrTayAtrAyAM pitfmAtfviyogataH । kacAnAM vapanaM kAryyaM vfTA na vikaco Bavet ॥” iti vizRupurARAt । iti prAyaScittatattvam ॥ prAyaScittapUrvvAhakftyaM yaTA । SaNKaliKitO । “vApya keSanaKAn pUrvvaM GftaM prASya vahirniSi pratyekaM niyataM kAlamAtmano vratamAdiSet ॥” iti prAyaScittatattvam ॥ (banDanam । yaTA, sAhityadarpaRe । 3 । 155 । “kApi kuntalasaMvyAnasaMyamavyapadeSataH । bAhumUlaM stanO nABipaNkajaM darSayet sPuwam ॥” saMkocaH । yaTA, mArkaRqeye । 77 । 4 । “mayi dfzwe sadA yasmAt kuruze netrasaMyamam । tasmAjjanizyate mUQe prajAsaMyamanaM yamam ॥”)
v: pu॰ sam + yama--GaY vA vfdDiH । vratANgatayA pUrvadinakarttavye 1 niyamaBede amaraH 2 indriyanigrahe 3 banDane ca
m: सं-यम m. holding together, restraint, control, (esp.) control of the senses, self-control, Mn.; MBh. &c.
tying up (the hair), Sāh.
binding, fettering, VarBṛS.
closing (of the eyes), MārkP.
concentration of mind (comprising the performance of Dhāraṇā, Dhyāna, and Samādhi, or the last three stages in Yoga), Yogas.; Sarvad.
effort, exertion (आ, ‘with great difficulty’), MBh.
suppression i.e. destruction (of the world), Pur.
N. of a son of Dhūmrākṣa (and father of Kṛśāśva), BhP.
a: संयमः — 1 Restraint, check, control; श्रोत्रादीनींद्रियाण्यन्ये संयमाग्निषु जुह्वति Bg. 4. 26, 27; so संयमधनः &c. --2 Concentration of mind, a term applied to the last three stages of Yoga; धारणाध्यानसमाधित्रयमंतरंगं संयमपदवाच्यं Sarva. S., Ku. 2. 59. --3 A religious vow. --4 Religious devotion, practice of penance; Ś. 4. 16. --5 Humanity, feeling of compassion. --6 Any religious act on the day preceding a vow or course of penance.

k.v: प्रवाहस्तु प्रवृत्तिः स्यात्प्रवहो गमनं बहिः। वियामो वियमो यामो यमः संयामसंयमौ॥

m: सं-यम—धन mfn. rich in self-restraint, MBh.

s: tri, (saMyacCatIti । saM + yam + Rvul । niyantA । yaTA, -- “sa eva DAtA sarvvasya tanniyogakarA vayam । yamasaMyamane tyaktaH so'smatsaMyamako hariH ॥” iti vahnipurARe nArasiMhaprAdurBAvADyAyaH ॥ saMyamI ca ॥
m: सं-˚यमक mfn. checking, restraining, VahniP.

s: strI, (saMmamyate'syAmiti । saM + yam + aDikaraRe lyuw .) yamapurI । iti medinI ॥ (yaTA, BAgavate । 10 । 45 । 42 । “tataH saMyamanIM nAma yamasya dayitAM purIm । gatvA janArddanaH SaNKaM pradaDmO sahalAyuDaH ॥”)
v: strI saMyamyate vaDyate'tra sam + yama--ADAre lyuw । yamADikftapuryyAm medi॰ “anye'pi ye saMyaminaH saMyamanyAmuSanti te” kASIKa॰ 8 a॰ । yamasaBAvarRanaM BA॰ sa॰ 8 a॰ dfSyam । saMyamananagaraparatve na॰ “etat saMyamanaM puRyamatIvAdButadarSanam” BA॰ va॰ 163 a॰ ।
m: सं-˚यमनी (ई), f. N. of the city or residence of Yama (fabled to be situated on Mount Meru), MBh.; BhP.

s: klI, (saM + yama + lyuw .) banDanam । (yaTA, sAhityadarpaRe । 6 । 318 । “yaTAvA veRyAM drOpadIkeSasaMyamanaheturBImasenakroDApacito yuDizwirotsAhaH ॥”) vratam । iti medinI ॥ catuHSAlam । iti saYjavanaSabdawIkAyAM BarataH ॥ (yamagfham । yaTA, mahABArate । 3 । 163 । 9 । “etat saMyamanaM puRyamatIvAdButadarSanam । pretarAjasya BavanamfdDyA paramayA yutam ॥” SAsanam । damanam । yaTA, BAgavate । 10 । 16 । 6 । “taM caRqavegavizavoryyamavekzya tena । duzwAM nadIYca KalasaMyamanAvatAraH ॥” * ॥ saMyacCatIti । saM + yama + lyuH । niyantari, tri । yaTA, mArkaRqeye । 77 । 4 । “tasmAjjanizyate mUQe prajAsaMyamanaM yam ॥”)
v: na॰ sam + yama--lyuw । 1 banDane 2 vrataBede medi॰ 3 ca tuHSAle gfhe ca BarataH । yama--Ric--lyu । 4 yame pu॰ “vEvasvataH saMyamanaH” SrutiH ।
m: सं-˚यमन mf(ई)n. id., MBh.; Pur.
bringing to rest, RV.
सं-˚यमन n. the act of curbing or checking or restraining, VP.
self-control, KauṣUp.
binding together, tying up, Vikr.; Sāh.
drawing tight, tightening (reins &c.), Śak.
confinement, fetter, Mṛcch.
Yama's residence (cf. above), Bādar.
a: संयमनं — 1 Restraining, checking. --2 Drawing in; Ś. 1. --3 Binding, tying up; U. 1; V. 3. 6. --4 Confinement. --5 Self-denial, control. --6 A religious vow or obligation. --7 A square of four houses. --नः One who restrains or regulates, a ruler. --नी N. of the city of Yama.

m: सं-यम—पुण्य-तीर्थ mfn. having restraint for a holy place of pilgrimage, MBh.
सं-यम—वत् mfn. self-controlled, parsimonious, economical, Kathās.

v: pu॰ sam + yama--Rini na vfdDiH । 1 hunimede DaraRiH 2 indriyasaMyamayute tri॰ gItA ।
m: सं-यमिन् mfn. who or what restrains or curbs or subdues, W.
one who subdues his passions, self-controlled (˚मि-ता f. self-control, Kād.), Hcat.
tied up (as hair), Bhartṛ.
सं-यमिन् m. a ruler, Divyāv.
an ascetic, saint, Ṛṣi, L.
a: संयमिन् — a. One who curbs or restrains, controlling. --m. One who controls or subdues his passions, a sage, an ascetic; या निशा सर्वभूतानां तस्यां जागर्ति संयमी Bg. 2. 69; R. 8. 11.

m: संयमि-नाम-मालिका f. N. of wk. (containing synonyms of names of Ṛṣis, by Śaṃkarācārya), Cat.
सं-यमिनी f. N. of the city Kāśī, KāśīKh.
N. of Yama's residence (also written सं-यमनी, q.v.), Śaṃk.
संयमिनी-पति m. N. of Yama, KāśīKh.
सं-यमि-ता f., self-control, Kād.

s: tri, jAtasaMyamaH । saMyamaSabdAt ito 'sya jAte ityanena itapratyayena nizpannaH ॥
m: सं-˚यमित mfn. (fr. Caus.) restrained, checked, subdued, Ragh.
bound, confined, fettered, Mṛcch.
clasped (in the arms), held, detained, Gīt.
piously disposed, R.
सं-˚यमित n. subduing (the voice), Mṛcch.
a: संयमित — p. p. 1 Restrained. --2 Bound, fettered. --3 Detained. --4 Assembled, collected.

m: सं-यम्य mfn. to be checked or restrained or subdued, Car.
सं-यन्तव्य mfn. to be restrained or controlled, MBh.
सं-˚यन्तृ mfn. one who restrains or controls, restraining, controlling (also as fut., ‘he will restrain’), ib.
सं-यन्त्रित mfn. (√ यन्त्र्) fastened with bands, held in, stopped, Śak.
सं-√ यस् cl. 4. 1. P. -यस्यति, -यसति, to make effort &c., Pāṇ. iii, 1, 72.

s: puM, strI, (saMyamyate'treti । saM + yam + kvip । “gamAdInAm .” 6 । 4 । 40 । ityamya vArttikoktyA malopaH । tuk .) yudDam । ityamaraBaratO ॥ (yaTA, raGuH । 7 । 39 । “utTApitaH saMyati reRuraSvEH sAndrIkftaH syandanavaMSacakrEH ॥”)
v: strI saMyamyate'tra sam + gama--ADAre kvip tuk ca । 1 yudDe amaraH । karttari kvip । 2 saMyamanakarttari tri॰ ।
m: सं-√ यत् Ā. -यतते, to unite (in trans.), meet together, encounter (rarely ‘as friends’, generally ‘as enemies’), contend, engage in contest or strife, quarrel (with संग्रामम्, ‘to begin a combat’), RV.; Br.; ChUp.; (P. ˚ति) to unite, join together (trans.), RV. vi, 67, 3.
सं-यत् mfn. (in some senses fr. सं-√ यम् below, Pāṇ. vi, 4, 40; Vop. 26, 78) coherent, contiguous, continuous, uninterrupted, RV.; ŚāṅkhŚr.
सं-यत् f. an agreement, covenant, stipulation, ŚBr.
a means of joining or uniting, TS.
an appointed place, RV. ix, 56, 15
contest, strife, battle, war (generally found in loc. or comp.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
सं-यत् f. N. of partic. bricks (-त्व n.), TS.
सं-यत् See above.
a: संयत् — {c1c} A. 1 To struggle, contend; देवासुरा वा एषु लोकेषु संयेतिरे. --2 To form or be formed in rows. --3 To agree, coincide.
संयत् — f. A battle, war, fight; यः संयति प्राप्तपिनाकिलीलः R. 6. 72, 7. 39; 18. 21; Ki. 1. 19; Śi. 16. 15. --Comp. --वरः a king, prince.

k.v: समुदायः स्त्रियः संयत्समित्याजिसमिद्युधः। नियुद्धं बाहुयुद्धेऽथ तुमुलं रणसङ्कुले॥

m: सं-य˚ताञ्जलि mfn. having the hands joined together in entreaty (= बद्धाञ्जलि), MW.
सं-य˚ताहार mfn. temperate in eating, MBh.
सं-य˚ताक्ष mfn. having the eyes closed, BhP.
सं-य˚तात्मन् mfn. (= ˚त-चेतस्), Mn. xi, 236
सं-यती n. du. of pr. p. of सम्- √ 5. इ (q.v.)

s: tri, (saM + yam + ktaH .) badDaH । ityamaraH ॥ (yaTA, rABAyaRe । 1 । 10 । 25 । “mAyAmiva pariBrazwAM hariRImiva saMyatAm ॥” kftasaMyamaH । yaTA brahmapurARam । “yo yaH kaScittIrTayAtrAntu gacCet susaMyataH sa ca pUrvvaM gfhe sve । kftopavAsaH SucirapramattaH saMpUjayedBaktinamro gaReSam ॥” iti prAyaScittatattvam ॥
v: tri॰ sam + yama--kta । 1 badDe amaraH 2 kftaSAstroktani yame ca ।
m: सं-यत mfn. held together, held in, held fast &c.
self-contained, self-controlled with regard to (loc. instr., or comp.), Gaut.; MBh. &c.
tied together, bound up, fettered, confined, imprisoned, captive, Mn.; MBh. &c.
shut up, closed (opp. to व्य्-आत्त), AV.
kept in order (see comp.)
suppressed, subdued, MBh.
= उद्यत, prepared, ready to (inf.), Hariv.
सं-यत m. ‘one who controls himself’, N. of Śiva, MBh.
a: संयत — p. p. 1 Restrained, curbed, subdued. --2 Tied up, bound together. --3 Fettered. --4 Captive, imprisoned, a prisoner; R. 3. 20. --5 Ready. --6 Arranged; see यम् with सं. --तः 1 One who has restrained his passions, an ascetic. --2 N. of Śiva. --Comp. --अक्ष a. one whose eyes are closed. --अंनलि a. one who has folded his hands in supplication. --आत्मन् a. self-subdued, self-controlled. --आहार a. temperate in eating. --उपस्कर a. one who has a well-regulated house, whose house-furniture is kept in good order. --चेतसू, --मनस् a. controlled in mind. --प्राण a. one whose breath is suppressed. --वाच् a. silent, taciturn, one who has held his tongue.

k.v: अधिक्षिप्तः प्रतिक्षिप्तो बद्धे कीलितसंयतौ। आपन्न आपत्प्राप्तः स्यात्कान्दिशीको भयद्रुतः॥

m: सं-यत—चेतस् mfn. controlled in mind, MW.
सं-˚यतक m. N. of a man, Kathās.
सं-यत—मानस mfn. (= -चेतस्), ib.
सं-यत—मैथुन mfn. one who abstains from sexual intercourse, MBh.
सं-यत—मुख mf(ई)n. (= -वाच्), Mṛcch.
सं-यत—प्राण mfn. having the breath suppressed or having the organs restrained, ib.
सं-यत—वाच् mfn. restrained in speech, taciturn, silent, MW.
सं-यत—वस्त्र mfn. having the dress or clothes fastened or tied together, Bhartṛ.
सं-यत—वत् mfn. self-controlled, self-possessed, Hariv.
सं-य˚तेन्द्रिय mfn. having the senses or passions controlled, ib.
सं-˚यति f. penance, self-castigation, Kuṭṭanīm.
सं-यतिन् See under सं. √ यम्.
सं-यतिन् mfn. controlling, restraining (the senses), MārkP. (prob. w.r. for सं-यमिन् below)
सं-य˚तोपस्कर mfn. having the household utensils kept in order, Yājñ.

s: [f] tri saMyamanakarttA । niyantA । saMpUrvvayamaDAtostfnpratyayena nizpannaH ॥ (yaTA, mahABArate । 4 । 62 । 48 । “taM visaMjYamapovAha saMyantA raTavAjinAm । upadeSamanusmftya rakzamARo mahAraTam ॥”)

m: सं-यत्त mfn. (pl.) come into conflict (संग्रामे सों-यत्ते, ‘at the outbreak of war’), TS.
prepared, ready, being on one's guard, Mn.; MBh. &c.
a: संयत्त — p. p. 1 Ready, prepared; Mv. 5. 51. --2 Being on guard.

m: सं-यत्—त्व n.

v: pu॰ sam + yama--kvarap tukca । 1 jantusamUhe 2 vAgyate tri॰ saMkziptasA॰ ।
m: सं-˚यत्वर m. = वाग्-यत or जन्तु-समूह, L.
a: संयत्वर — a. Silent.

m: सं-यवन n. mixing, mingling, Jaim.; VS., Sch.
a square of four houses (= or w.r. for संजवन), MW.
सं-योध m. fight, battle
सं-योध—कण्टक m. ‘a thorn in battle’, N. of a Yakṣa, R.
सं-योद्धव्य n. (impers.) it is to be fought, MBh.
सं-योद्धृ See प्रति-संय्˚.

s: [n] tri, (saMyogo'syAstIti । saMyoga + iniH .) saMyogaviSizwaH । yaTA, -- “agre vfkzaH kapisaMyogI na mUle .” iti sidDAntalakzaRajAgadISI ॥

puM, (saM + yuj + GaY .) melanam । nyAyamate guRapadArTaH । sa ca sambanDaviSezaH । aprAptavastudvayasya prAptiH । sa ca triviDo yaTA । ekakarmmajanyaH । yaTA parvvate pakzisaMyogaH ॥ 1 ॥ uBayamarmmajanyaH । yaTA mezadvayasaMyogaH ॥ 2 ॥ saMyogajanyasaMyogaH । yaTA kapAlatarusaMyogajanyatarukumBasaMyogaH ॥ 3 ॥ karmmajanyasaMyogo'pi dviviDaH । aBiGAtaH । tasmAt Sabdo jAyate ॥ 1 ॥ nodanaH । tasmAt Sabdo na jAyate ॥ 2 ॥ atra pramARam । “aprAptayostu yA prAptiH sEva saMyoga IritaH । kIrttitastriviDastveza Adyo'nyatarakarmmajaH ॥ taToBayoH karmmajanyo Bavet saMyogajo'paraH । AdimaH SyenaSElAdisaMyogaH parikIrttitaH ॥ mezayoH sannipAto yaH sa dvitIya udAhftaH । kapAlatarusaMyogAt saMyogastarukumBayoH ॥ dvitIyaH syAt karmmajo'pi dviDEva parikIrttitaH aBiGAto nodanaSca SabdaheturihAdimaH । SabdAheturddvitIyaH syAdviBAgo'pi triDA Bavet ॥” iti BAzAparicCedaH ॥ * ॥ udayAt pUrvvaM daSaByAH SezaH । yaTA, -- “udayAt prAk daSamyAstu SezaH saMyoga izyate । uparizwAt praveSastu tasmAt tAM parivarjjayet ॥” iti tiTyAditattvam ॥ sambanDamAtram । iti saMyogapfTaktvanyAyArTadarSanAt ॥
v: pu॰ sam + yuja--GaY । 1 melane kriyAjanye dravyASrite guRaBede 2 sambanDamAtre ca “aprAptayostu yA prAptiH sEva saMyoga IritaH । kIrttitastriviDaKyeza Adyo'myatara karmajaH । taToBayoH karmajanyo Bavet saMyogajo'paraH । AdimaH SyenaSElAdisaMyogaH parikIrttitaH । mezayoH sannipAtoyaH sa dvitIya udAhftaH । kapAlatarusaMyogAt saMyogastarukumBayoH । tftIyaH syAt karmajo'pi dviDEva parikIrttitaH । aBiGAto godanaSca SabdaheturihAdimaH । SabdAheturdvitIyaH syAt” BAzA॰ “udayAt prAk daSamyAstu SezaH saMyoga ucyate । uparizwAt praveSastu tasmAt tat parivarjayet” ti॰ ta॰ ukte udayAt prAkdaSamyAH Seze ca ।
m: सं-योग m. conjunction, combination, connection (˚गे or ˚गेषु ifc. ‘in connection with, with regard to, concerning’), union or absorption with or in (gen., or instr. with and without सह, or loc., or ifc.), Āpast.; MBh. &c.

contact (esp. in phil. ‘direct material contact’, as of sesamum seed with rice-grains [in contradistinction to contact by the fusion of particles, as of water with milk], enumerated among the 24 Guṇas of the Nyāya cf. under सम्-बन्ध), Yogas.; Kaṇ.; Bhāṣāp.
carnal contact, sexual union, MBh. &c.
matrimonial connection or relationship by marriage with or between (gen., सह with instr., or comp.), Gaut.; Mn.; MBh. &c.
a kind of alliance or peace made between two kings with a common object, Kām.; Hit.
agreement of opinion, consensus (opposed to भेद), R.
applying one's self closely to, being engaged in, undertaking (˚गं √ कृ, ‘to undertake, set about, begin’; अग्निहोत्र-संयोगम् √ कृ, ‘to undertake the maintenance of a sacred fire’), Āpast.; Mn.; R.
(in gram.) a conjunct consonant, combination of two or more consonants, Prāt.; Pāṇ. &c.
dependence of one case upon another, syntax, Vop.
(in astron.) conjunction of two or more heavenly bodies, MW.
total amount, sum, VarBṛS.
N. of Śiva, MBh.
a: संयोगः — 1 (a) Conjunction, union, combination, junction, association, intimate union; संयोगो हि वियोगस्य संसूचयति संभवं Subhāṣ. (b) Endowment with, possession of. --2 Conjunction (as one of the 24 guṇas of the Vaiśeṣikas). --3 Addition, annexation. --4 A set; आभरणसंयोगाः Māl. 6. --5 Alliance between two kings for a common object. --6 (In gram.) A conjunct consonant; हलोऽनंतराः संयोगः P. I. 1. 7. --7 (In astr.) The conjunction of two heavenly bodies. --8 An epithet of Śiva. --Comp. --पृथक्त्वं severalty of conjunction. --विरुद्धं any eatables causing disease by being mixed.

m: सं-योग—मन्त्र m. a nuptial text or formula, Gaut.

s: klI, (saMyogena PalasambanDaBedena pfTaktvaM, nAnAviDatvaM yatra .) nyAyaviSezaH । yaTA । ekasya karmmaRo nityatvakAmyatvAByAM dvErUpyANgIkAre nityAnityasaMyagaviroDaH । mEvaM saMyogapfTaktvanyAyAt । sa ca nyAyaScaturTADyAye uktaH । yaTA । KAdire paSuM baDnAti KAdiraM vIryyakAmasya yUpaM kurvvIta iti SrUyate । aSra saSayaH । kiM kAmyasyEva KAdiratA nitye'pi syAduta neti । tatra PalArTatvenAnityatayA nityaprayogANgatA na yuktA । yattu nitya'pi KAdiratvaSravaRaM tat kAmyasyEva paSunanDanAya yUpASrayajYApanArTaM ato na nitye KAdiratA iti prApte rAdDAntAya caturTADyAyasUtram । ekasya tUBayatve saMyogapfTaktvamiti । atra saMyogaH sambanDamAtraM pfTaktvaM BedaH । ekasya KAdirasya kratvarTatvapuruzArTatvarUpoBayAtmakatve vAkyadvayena cakratuSezatvaPalaSezatvalakzaRasaMyogaBedAvagamAnna nityAnityasaMyogaviroDaH । na cASrayajYAnArTaM nityavAkyaM sanniDAnAdevASrayalABAt । ata uBayArTA KAdirateti । evaM daDnA juhoti daDnendriyakAmasya ityAdAvuBayArTatEva । daDitvasya dveDASravaRAt । iti prAyaScittatattvam ॥
v: na॰ saMyogena PalasambanDaBedena pfTaktvaM nAnArUpatvaM yatra । ekasyEva karmaRo nityAnityatvapratipAdake mImAsakokte nyAyaBede sa ca ta ttvabo॰ darSito yaTA “agnIzomIyapaSO SrUyate “KAdire paSuM vaGnAti KAdiraM vIryyakAmasya yUpaM kurvIta” । atra paSubanDanAyayUpovihataH sa ca nityatvenAvaSyakaH yAgasADanatvAt paSukAmanAvataSca anyoyUpovihitaH sa ca kAmanADInatvAnnAvaSyakaH । atra saMsayaH kiM kAmya eva KAdiro nitye'pi syAt uta ekaH KAdiraH kratupuruzoBayArTaH uta kAmya eva KAdiro nityastvanyakAzWanirmita iti । tatra kAmyanityaprayogANgatA na samBavati kAmanADInatvena tasyAnAvaSyakatvAt nityaScAvaSyakaH nahyekasyAvaSyakatva manAvaSyakatvaYca samBavati viroDAt । tasmAt kAmya eva KAdiraH nityaScAnyakAzWanirmitaH । taduktaM SAstradIpikAyAm etadaDikaraRIyodAharaRAntare “daGnA juhoti daDnendriyakAmasyetyaDikftya “pUrvADikaraRanyAyAt kAmyatvena SrutaM daDi । anityArTasupAdeyamato'nyannityamizyatAm” । anyaddravyAntaraM pUrvADikaraRanyAyAt prAguktApa praRayananyAyAt । mADavAcAryyo'pi “nitye'gnihotre pUrvADikaraRanyAyena daDi na prayoktavyaM kintu anyadeva kiYcit dravyam” ityAha । nanu nitye'pi KAdira eva SrUyate Rato nitya ekaH svAdiraH kAmyaScAnyaH svAdira iti yUpadvayaM viDoyate anyaTA nitye KAdiratvaHBiDAnaM vyarTaM syAt taTA ca kva viroDaH yenEkasyoBayArTatve viroDamASaNkya samAhitamiti cenna svAdireRa vIryyaM kuryyAdityarTakatvazaryyavasannaM svAdiratvABiDAnaM vyarTamiti tasmAnnitye svAdirAviDAnAt kAmya eva svAdiraH nityastu kAzWAntarIya iti prApte Aha “ekasya tUBayatve saMyogapfTaktvam” sU॰ saMyogaH sambanDaH ekasya KAdirasya nityatvakAmyatvoBayarUpatve saMyogasya paSusambanDasya pfTakatvaM parasparanirapekzeRa pfTagaBiDAnaM niyAmakamiti SezaH । ayamBAvaH yadi dvayorekasya vAkANkzA tadA dvayorekavAkyatA iha tu uBayameva nirAkANkzaM taTA hi nityavAkyaM yUpasya paSubanDanasamyanDe alOkikaM kimapi nApekzate paSubanDanadfzwaPasatvAt ccAmbarvAkyAmanupanyasyABiDAnAcca । kAmyavAkyamapi ASrayasambanDakaraM kimapi pramARaM nApekzate sanniDAnAdevASrayalABe hi taTA syAt pfTakpfTak saMyogasya nirapekzeRa vAkyadvayenABiDAnAt kAsanAsattve ca KAdiraM dfzwaPaladvArA kratorupakarivyati puruzasya vI ryyamapyAvakzyati । kistvayaM viSezaH kAmanAsattve tatsahakAreRa puruzArTastadaBAvena ca katparTa iti । taduktam “dvayorekasya vAkANkzA Baved yadi tayostataH । prakalpyetEkavAkyatvaM nirAkANkzantvihoBayamiti” tasmAduBayArTA KAdirateti । nanu nitya eva KAdiro'stu KAdiramityAdinA'Ngasya praSaMsArTaM PalaSrutyarTavAdo'stu yaTA yasya parRamayI juhUrBavati na sa pApaSlokaM SfRoti” ityatreti kimekasyoBayArTatvANgIkAreReti cenna tatra jUhuprAptAvapi tannizyAdakadravyaviSezaRAmAvAt tatparicAyakatvenEva stutyarTavAdasyOcityAt na cAtra taTA pUrvavAkyata eva KAdiratvaprAptO punaH KAdirapadApanyAsenAnyasya vIryasAmarTyakatvaboDanenEkaprayojanakatvAt । evaM daDnA juhoti daDnendriyakAmasya juhUyAdityAdAvapi uBayArTatA daDno boDyA uBayatra daDnaH kIrttanAt” ।
m: सं-योग—पृथक्-त्व n. (in phil.) separateness with conjunction (a term applied to express the separateness of what is optional from what is a necessary constituent of anything), MW.

s: klI, (saMyogena virudDam .) parasparasaMyogena rogajanakaKAdyadravyam । yaTA, -- “SAkAmlapalapiRyAkakulatTalavaRAmizEH । karIradaDimAzESca prAyaH kzIraM viruDyate ॥ prARahArI tu hArIto haridrAlavaREH SftaH । rurostEle'nalErBfzwaM vizaM mAyUramAmizam ॥ varAhavasayA BfzwA valAkA tu haratyasUn । saMyuktA sEva vAruRyA kulmAzaMSca biruDyate ॥ aviM kusumBaSAkena matsyatElEH kaRAM tyajet । mAMsErikzavikArAMSca kAYjikEstilaSaskulIm ॥ kapotaH sArzape Bfzwo GftaM kAMsye daSAhagam । vizaM GftasamaM kzOdraM maDunA gaganAmbu ca ॥ mUlakaM mAzasUpena maDunA ca na Bakzayet । ekatra sarvvamAMsAni viruDyante parasparam ॥ rAtryanDavIsarpadakodarARAM vizPowikonmAdaBagandarARAm । mUrcCAmadADmAnagalagrahARAM pARqvAmayasyAmavizasya cEva ॥ kilAsakuzWagrahaRIgadAnAM SoTAtisArajvarapInasAnAm । santAnadozasya taTEva mftyorvvirudDamannaM pravadanti hetum ॥ virudDAhArajAn rogAn vinihanti virecanam । vamanaM SamanaM vApi pUrvvaM vA hitasevanam ॥” iti saMyogavirudDam । iti rAjavallaH ॥
v: na॰ saMyogena virudDam । dravyAntarasaMyogena virudDaguRASraye dravyaBede tacca rAjavallaBena darSitaM yaTA “SAkAmlapalapiRyAkakulatTalavaRAmizEH । karIradaDimAzESca prAyaH kzIraM viruDyate । prARahArI tu hArIto haridrAlavaREH SftaH । rurostElAnalErBfzwaM vizaM mAyUramAmizam । varAhavasayA BfzwA balAkA tu haratyasUn । saMyuktA sEva vAruRyA kulmAzESca viruDyate । aviM kfsumBaSAkena matsyatElEH kaRAM tyajet । mAMsErikzuvikArAMSca kAYjikEstilaSaskulIm । kapotaH sArzape Bfzwo GftaM kAMsye daSAhikam । vizaM GftasamaM kzOdraM maDunA gaganAmbu ca । mUlakaM mAzasUpena maDunA ca na Bakzayet । ekatra sarvamAMsAni viruDyante prasparam । rAtryanDavIsarpadakodarARAM visPowikonmAdaBagandarARAm । mUrcCAmadADmAnagalagrahARAM pARqvAmayasyA''mavizasya cEva kilAsakuzWagrahaRIgadAnAM SoTAtisArajvarapInasAnAm । santAnadozasya taTEva mftyorvirudDamannaM pravadanti hetum । virudDAhArajAn rogAt vigihanti virecanam । vaBanaM SamanaM vApi pUrvaM vA hitasevanam” ।
m: सं-योग—विरुद्ध n. food which causes disease through being mixed, MW.
सं-˚योगिन् mfn. being in contact or connection, closely connected with (instr. or comp.), Kaṇ.; Śaṃk.; MārkP.
united (with a loved object; opp. to विरहिन्), Kāvyād., Sch.
married, W.
conjunct, one of the consonants in a combination of c˚, Pāṇ. i, 2, 27, Sch.
a: संयोगिन् — a. 1 United, conjoined. --2 Joining.

s: tri, jAtasaMyogaH । saMyogaSabdAditapratyayena nizpannaH । iti saMyojitaSabdawIkAyAM BarataH ॥
m: सं-˚योगित mfn. = (or w.r. for) ˚योजित, L.
सं-˚यो˚गि-त्व n. close connection, Sarvad.
सं-योजक mfn. joining together, connecting, uniting, MW.
bringing together or about, occasioning (comp.), Gaut.

s: klI, (saM + yuj + lyuw .) mETunam । iti hArAvalI ॥ saMyogaSca ॥
v: na॰ sam + yuja--Ric--ADArAdO lyuw । 1 mETune hArA॰ । 2 samyagyojane ca ।
m: सं-˚योजन n. the act of joining or uniting with (instr. or loc.), ŚBr. &c. &c.
all that binds to the world, cause of re-birth, Divyāv.
copulation, sexual union, L.
(with मित्रा-वरुणयोः, अश्विनोः, and प्रहितोः) N. of Sāmans, ĀrṣBr.,
a: संयोजनं — 1 Union, conjunction. --2 Copulation, sexual union.

m: सं-˚योजयितव्य mfn. to be joined or united, Kāraṇḍ.

s: tri, (saM + yuja + Ric + ktaH .) padArTaH padArTAntareRa saMyuktIkftaH । tatparyyAyaH upAhitaH 2 । ityamaraH ॥ saMyogitaH 3 । iti BarataH ॥ (yaTA, BAgavate । 5 । 23 । 3 । “yaTAmeDIstamBa AkramaRapaSavaH saMyojitAH । triBiH savanEryaTAsTAnaM maRqalAni caranti ॥”)
v: tri॰ sam + yuja--Ric kta । kftamelane padArTAntareRa kftayojane padArTe
m: सं-˚योजित mfn. (fr. Caus.) conjoined, attached &c., BhP.

k.v: वृत्ते तु वृत्तव्यावृत्तौ संयोजित उपाहितः। प्राप्यं गम्यं समासाद्यं  स्यन्नं रीणं स्नुतं स्रुतम्.।

m: सं-˚योजित—कर-युगल mfn. one who has both his hands joined together, ib.
सं-˚योज्य mfn. to be joined or brought together, to be fixed upon (loc.), MBh.

सं-√ 2. यु P. Ā. -यौति, -युते; -युनाति, ˚नीते (Ved. also -युवति, ˚ते), to join or unite with one's self, take into one's self, devour, RV.; to join to another, bestow on, impart, RV. v, 32, 10; to join together, connect with (instr.), unite, mix, mingle, VS.; TBr.; KātyŚr.; Bhaṭṭ.

सं-√ युध् Ā. -युध्यते (rarely P. ˚ति), to fight together, fight with, combat, oppose (instr. with or without सार्धम्), MBh.; R.; BhP. : Caus. -योधयति, to cause to fight together, bring into collision, RV.; to fight, encounter, MBh. : Desid., -युयुत्सति, to wish to fight, be eager for battle, MBh. (cf. next).

s: puM, (“yujira yoge + GaY । ukTAdizu yugaSabdasya pAWAt nipAtanAdaguRatvam । ‘viSezo'sO nipAtanamizyate kAlaviSeze raTAdyupakaraSe ca .’ iti vfttiH । saNgatA raTayugA yasmin vA .” iti niruktawIkAyAM devarAjayajvA । 2 । 17 । 29 .) yudDam । ityamaraH । 2 8 । 105 ॥ (yaTA, mahABArate । 2 । 17 । 5 । “anayasyAnupAyasya saMyuge paramaH kzayaH । saSayo jAyate sAmyAt jayaSca na Bavet dvayoH ॥” saMyogaSca ॥
v: na॰ saMyujyate'tra sam + yuja--ka nyaNkvA॰ jasya gaH । yudDe amaraH । tatra sADu॰ KaY । sAMyugIna raResADO ।
m: सं-युग n. (in BhP. also m.) union, conjunction, MBh.
conflict, battle, war, MBh.; Kāv. &c. (cf. Naigh. ii, 17)
a: संयुगः — 1 Conjunction, union, mixture. --2 Fight, war, battle, contest; संयुगे सांयुगीनं तमुद्यतं प्रसहेत कः Ku. 2. 57; R. 9. 19. --Comp. --गोष्पदं ‘a contest in a cow's footstep’; i. e. an insignificant or trifling quarrel; cf. the English phrase ‘a storm in a tea-pot’.

k.v: सम्प्रहाराभिसम्पात कलिसंस्फोट संयुगाः। अभ्यामर्द समाघात संग्रामाभ्यागमाहवाः॥

m: सं-युग—गोष्पद n. a contest in a cow's footstep (met. ‘an insignificant struggle’), MBh.
सं-युग—मूर्धन् m. the van or front of battle, Ragh.

v: tri॰ samyak yunakti sam + yaja--kvin । 1 guRAQye trikA॰ 2 saMyukte ca ।
m: सं-√ युज् P. Ā. -युनक्ति, -युङ्क्ते, to join or attach together, conjoin, connect, combine, unite, RV. &c. &c.; to bind, fetter, Vait.; to endow or furnish with (instr.), ŚvetUp.; MBh. &c.; to form an alliance, league together, RV. viii, 62, 11; to place in, fix on, direct towards (loc.), MBh.; BhP. : Pass. -युज्यते, to be joined together, be united &c.; to meet or fall in with (instr.), Ragh.; to be married to (instr.), Mn. ix, 22; (with रत्या, or ग्राम्यधर्मतया) to have sexual intercourse, PraśnUp.; Śaṃk. on ChUp.; to be supplied or furnished with (instr.), MBh.; R. &c.: Caus. -योजयति, to cause to join together, bring together, unite, MBh.; Kathās.; MārkP.; to put to (horses), yoke, harness, ib.; to hold together, check, control (the senses), MaitrUp. (v.l.); to furnish or endow or present with (instr.), Yājñ.; MBh. &c.; to give over to, entrust with (gen. of pers. and acc. of thing), R.; Pañcat.; to add to (loc.), Sūryas.; to fix on, direct towards (loc.), MaitrUp.; MBh.; BhP.; to shoot, discharge (a missile), MBh.; to equip (an army), ib.; to use, employ, appoint, ib.; to institute, perform, accomplish, Hariv.; BhP.; (Ā.) to be absorbed, meditate, MBh. v, 7260.
सं-युज् mfn. joined together, united, connected, related, MBh.; BhP.
सं-युज् m. a relation, Śiś.
सं-युज् f. union, connection (= सं-योग), BhP., Sch.
a: संयुज् — {c7c} U. 1 To join together, connect, unite. --2 To endow or furnish with. --3 To form an alliance. --4 To place or fix in, set in. --Pass. To be united with; संयोक्ष्यसे स्वेन वर्पुमहिम्ना R. 5. 55. --Caus. 1 To unite, join; संयोजयति विद्यैव नीचगापि नरंसरित् H. 1. --2 To harness, yoke. --3 To prepare, equip (an army). --4 To furnish, endow or supply with, provide with; बुद्ध्या संयो जयंति तं Pt. 2. --5 To fasten or fix on. --6 To throw, discharge, shoot (a missile). --7 To use, employ. --8 To appoint (to an office), entrust with. --9 To perform, accomplish. --To be absorbed in, meditate upon.
संयुज् — a. 1 Connected, relating to; Śi. 14. 55. --2 Possessed of or endowed with good qualities.

s: [j] tri, (saM + yuj + kvip .) guRavAn । yaTA, -- “sambanDI guRavAn saMyuk mitrayuNmitravatsalaH .” iti trikARqaSezaH । (yaTA, mahABArate । 2 । 36 । 22 । “AcAryyamftvijaYcEva saMyujaYca yuDizWira । snAtakaYca priyaM prAhuH zaqarGArhAn nfpaM taTA ॥”) saMyuktaSca ॥

m: सं-युक्ता (आ), f. a kind of metre, Col.
सं-युक्˚ताभिधर्म-शास्त्र n. N. of a Buddh. wk.
सं-युक्˚तागम m. N. of a Buddh. Āgama
संयुक्ताक्षर n. a conjunct letter, Prāt.

s: tri, (saM + yuj + ktaH .) saMyogASrayaH । yaTA, tiTyAditattve । “kuryyAdalABe saMyuktAM nAlABe'pi praveSinIma ॥”
v: tri॰ sam + yuja--kta । 1 saMyogayute padArTe 2 acAnantarite halvarRe ca pA॰ ।
m: सं-युक्त mfn. conjoined, joined together, combined, united (pl., ‘all together’), TS. &c. &c.
conjunct (as consonants), Pāṇ. vi, 3, 59, Sch.
connected, related (= सम्बन्धिन्), PārGṛ.
married to (instr.), Mn. ix, 23
placed, put, fixed in (loc.), MBh.
accompanied or attended by, endowed or furnished with, full of (instr. or comp.), Mn.; MBh. &c.
(ifc.) connected with, relating to, concerning, KātyŚr.; MBh. &c.
a: संयुक्त — p. p. 1 Joined, connected, united. --2 Blended, mixed, mingled. --3 Accompanied by. --4 Possessed of, endowed with. --5 Consisting of.

m: सं-युक्तम् (अम्), ind. jointly, together, at the same time, ŚvetUp.
सं-युक्त—संचय-पिटक m. N. of wk.
सं-युक्त—संयोग m. connection with the connected (e.g. the connection of a trace with a horse), Kaṇ.
सं-युक्त—समवाय m. inherence in the connected (one of the six kinds of perception in Nyāya), Tarkas.
सं-युक्त—समवेत-समवाय m. inherence in that which inheres in the connected, ib.
सं-√ युप् Caus. -योपयति, to efface, obliterate, remove, RV.

s: tri, saMyuktaH । yaTA, -- “caturTIsaMyutA kAryyA paYcamI parayA na tu । dEve karmmaRi petre ca Suklapakze taTAsite ॥” iti tiTyAditattvam ॥
m: सं-युत mfn. joined or bound together, tied, fettered, R.; Ragh.
put together, joined or connected with (instr. with and without सह, or comp.), AV. &c. &c.
increased by, added to (instr. or comp.), VarBṛS.; Rājat.
(ifc.) being in conjunction with, VarBṛS.
consisting of, containing (instr. or comp.), R.
(ifc.) relating to, implying (प्रैष्य-स्˚, ‘implying service’), Mn. ii, 32
accumulated (v.l. for सम्-भृत), Śak. iv, 120/121
a: संयुत — p. p. 1 Joined, united together, connected. --2 Endowed or furnished with.

m: सं-˚युति f. the total of two numbers or quantities, Bījag.
the conjunction of planets, Gaṇit.
सं-युयूषु mfn. (fr. Desid.) wishing to join together, wishing to unite with (instr.), Bhaṭṭ.
सं-युयुत्सु mfn. (fr. Desid.) wishing to fight, eager for battle, Rājat.
